name: Alcaldía de Palmira
body: A GovernmentOrganization in JSON-LD, a sitemap index, alt text on every image, and a permanent https redirect. But 16 of the pages analyzed, the home page among them, have no meta description.
lesson: Write a description of about 150 characters for each key page, so you choose the snippet, not the crawler.
summary: palmira.gov.co scores 74 out of 100 (C). 3 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 16 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 16 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Analytics may count some visits twice
fix.evidence: 15 pages load gtag.js more than once.
fix.fix: Keep one GA4 property per site and load gtag.js once, or manage it only inside Tag Manager.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 16 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /transparencia/, /servicios/atencion-a-la-ciudadania/, /servicios/peticiones-quejas-y-reclamos/ and 12 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 16 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 686 ms
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
